focus: Public open-source research for verified active projects: Genesis, ABVM, PermitPlate, CaptureBrief, Portfolio Brain and RETALLY. Retired project research is out of scope.
rules: Search only public repositories for relevant, lawful, rights-reviewable reusable technology; target repositories are context, not destinations for automated writes.
Prioritize direct usefulness to the assigned active project's known product and test surfaces; do not source changes for retired projects.
Preserve exact revisions, source provenance, license limitations, independent verification gaps and evidence of implementation; discovery is not delivery.
No live publishing, merging, spending, customer outreach, child records, medical records, credentials, leaked/private material or unsafe access techniques.
Unlicensed code is research/reference only until specific reuse rights are proven. Private target repositories must never be scraped or copied into public discovery output.
